# 1. Data and variables

I use the two LADBS **Building Permits Issued** extracts from the LA Open Data portal
(permits issued 2010–2019 and 2020–present; both refreshed **November 1, 2026**, downloaded
November 7, 2026). Each row is one issued permit. The variables I rely on:

| Variable | What it is | How I use it |
|---|---|---|
| `PERMIT_NBR` | 15-digit permit number, `XXXXX-YYYYY-NNNNN`. Supplemental permits (plan revisions on the same job) increment the middle group: `-20000` → `-20001`, `-20002`, … | Grouping supplements with their parent permit |
| `ADU_CHANGED`, `JUNIOR_ADU` | **Net change** in ADU / Junior ADU units on the structural inventory — not 0/1 flags. Mostly +1; legitimately 2–43 for multifamily conversions; negative for removals, demolitions, and corrections. Populated **only from 2017 onward**, which is why the series starts in 2017. | Identifying ADU permits and counting units |
| `COFO_DATE` | Certificate of Occupancy date. Filled for essentially all `CofO Issued` permits and almost nothing else | Completion demarcation (with `STATUS_DESC`) |
| `STATUS_DESC` | Current permit status (CofO Issued, Issued, Permit Finaled, Permit Expired, …) | Validity and completion |
| `ISSUE_DATE` | Date the permit was issued | Year assignment |
| `CPA` | Community Plan Area | Geography (normalized in Step 6) |
| `PIN_NBR` | Parcel identification number | Property-level collapse |
| `LAT`, `LON` | Geocoded location | Maps |

Three universe caveats to keep in mind: (1) these are **issued** permits — applications
never issued, and unpermitted ADUs, are absent; (2) 2026 is a **partial year** (through
~Nov 1, 2026); (3) completion status is as of the data refresh — a 2024 permit shown
"in progress" may simply still be under construction.

```{r load}
keep_cols <- c("PERMIT_NBR","PIN_NBR","APN","CPA","PERMIT_TYPE","USE_DESC",
               "ISSUE_DATE","COFO_DATE","ADU_CHANGED","JUNIOR_ADU",
               "STATUS_DESC","WORK_DESC","LAT","LON")
raw <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(params$path_2010s, col_select = all_of(keep_cols),
           col_types = cols(.default = col_character())),
  read_csv(params$path_2020s, col_select = all_of(keep_cols),
           col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
)

# running filter log ("waterfall") I add to at each step
log_tbl <- tibble(step = "0. Raw permit rows, both files",
                  remaining = nrow(raw), dropped = NA_integer_)
kable(log_tbl, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 2. Step 1 — Flag ADU permit rows

A permit is ADU-related when `ADU_CHANGED + JUNIOR_ADU` nets to something other than
zero. I keep negatives at this stage **on purpose**: they are corrections and removals
that I need later to net against erroneous positives. Only rows that net to exactly
zero *within the row* drop here (e.g., `ADU_CHANGED = -1, JUNIOR_ADU = +1`, an ADU
reclassified as a JADU — no change in stock).

```{r step1}
adu_rows <- raw %>%
  mutate(across(c(ADU_CHANGED, JUNIOR_ADU), ~replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)),
         units_row = ADU_CHANGED + JUNIOR_ADU,
         issue_dt  = mdy(ISSUE_DATE),
         cofo_dt   = mdy(COFO_DATE)) %>%
  filter(units_row != 0)

log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "1. Rows where ADU_CHANGED + JUNIOR_ADU nets ≠ 0",
                   remaining = nrow(adu_rows),
                   dropped = log_tbl$remaining[nrow(log_tbl)] - nrow(adu_rows))
kable(log_tbl, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 3. Step 2 — Collapse supplemental permits into projects

Supplemental permits are plan revisions on the same construction job, and they often
**restate** the parent permit's ADU count — so counting rows double-counts. I group every
permit to its parent ("project") by zeroing the supplement counter in the middle group of
the permit number (`16010-20002-04817` → `16010-20000-04817`).

Within a project, I set **units = largest positive claim + the sum of negative
corrections**. Two things this handles automatically: (a) a supplement restating the
parent's `+1` no longer adds a second unit; (b) data-entry corrections net out — e.g.,
one permit recorded **+859 ADUs** (the unit's square footage typed into the unit field)
and its supplement recorded **−858**, netting to the true 1. Some projects' ADU flag
lives *only* on a supplement (scope changed to an ADU mid-stream), so I group on the
full universe of rows belonging to flagged projects, not just flagged rows.

```{r step2}
parse_root <- function(pn) {
  m <- str_match(pn, "^(\\d{5})-(\\d{5})-(\\d{5})$")
  mid <- as.integer(m[, 3])
  paste0(m[, 2], "-", sprintf("%05d", (mid %/% 10000) * 10000), "-", m[, 4])
}

raw2 <- raw %>%
  mutate(across(c(ADU_CHANGED, JUNIOR_ADU), ~replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)),
         units_row = ADU_CHANGED + JUNIOR_ADU,
         issue_dt  = mdy(ISSUE_DATE),
         cofo_dt   = mdy(COFO_DATE),
         mid       = as.integer(str_sub(PERMIT_NBR, 7, 11)),
         is_suppl  = mid %% 10000 != 0,
         root      = parse_root(PERMIT_NBR))

adu_roots <- unique(raw2$root[raw2$units_row != 0])

completed_statuses <- c("CofO Issued","CofO Corrected","CofO Superseded",
                        "CofC Issued","Permit Finaled")
invalid_statuses   <- c("Permit Expired","Permit Closed",
                        "Refund in Progress","Intent to Revoke")

projects <- raw2 %>%
  filter(root %in% adu_roots) %>%
  group_by(root) %>%
  arrange(issue_dt, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    units_raw_sum = sum(units_row),
    units = max(c(units_row[units_row > 0], 0)) + sum(units_row[units_row < 0]),
    # year/location/parcel from the first ADU-flagged permit in the project
    first_flag = list(slice_head(filter(pick(everything()), units_row != 0), n = 1)),
    status_orig = first(STATUS_DESC[!is_suppl], default = first(STATUS_DESC)),
    any_cofo    = any(!is.na(cofo_dt)),
    completed   = any_cofo | any(STATUS_DESC %in% completed_statuses),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest_wider(first_flag, names_sep = "_") %>%
  transmute(root, units_raw_sum, units,
            issue_year = year(first_flag_issue_dt),
            pin  = first_flag_PIN_NBR, apn = first_flag_APN,
            cpa_raw = first_flag_CPA,
            lat = as.numeric(first_flag_LAT), lon = as.numeric(first_flag_LON),
            work_desc = first_flag_WORK_DESC,
            status_orig, any_cofo, completed)

phantom_units <- sum(pmax(projects$units_raw_sum - projects$units, 0))
log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl,
  step = sprintf("2. Collapse supplements into parent permit ('project'); removes %s phantom units vs naive row-sum",
                 comma(phantom_units)),
  remaining = nrow(projects),
  dropped = log_tbl$remaining[nrow(log_tbl)] - nrow(projects))
kable(log_tbl, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 4. Step 3 — Fix unit-count typos

Four projects have square footage typed into the unit-count field with **no** correcting
supplement (values of 14, 378, 711, and 1,178). Each work description plainly describes a
single ADU ("Convert existing attached garage to new ADU…"), so I set them to 1. I
reviewed every project above 10 units: the rest (11–43 units) are genuine multifamily
conversions under Gov. Code 65852.2(e)(1)(C), with the unit count corroborated by the work
description ("CONVERSION OF 43 STORAGE ROOMS IN APARTMENT BUILDING TO ACCESSORY
DWELLINGS"), so those stay.

```{r step3}
typo_roots <- c("21014-20000-05640","22016-20000-05796",
                "24016-20000-02447","21014-10000-05465")
units_before <- sum(pmax(projects$units, 0))
projects <- projects %>%
  mutate(units = if_else(root %in% typo_roots & units > 1, 1, units))
log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl,
  step = sprintf("3. Fix 4 sq-footage-as-unit-count typos (gross units %s -> %s)",
                 comma(units_before), comma(sum(pmax(projects$units, 0)))),
  remaining = nrow(projects), dropped = 0L)
kable(log_tbl, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 5. Step 4 — Drop projects that net ≤ 0 ADUs

What remains at zero or below after netting is not ADU construction: demolitions
(every demolition permit carries −1 to −3), ADU removals, and scopes reversed by
supplement. These reduce or leave unchanged the ADU stock, so they exit here.

```{r step4}
n_before <- nrow(projects)
projects <- filter(projects, units > 0)
log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl, step = "4. Drop projects with net ADU change <= 0 (demolitions, removals, reversed scopes)",
                   remaining = nrow(projects), dropped = n_before - nrow(projects))
kable(log_tbl, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 6. Step 5 — Drop invalid permits

A permit can be issued and then die: statuses **Permit Expired**, **Permit Closed**,
**Refund in Progress**, and **Intent to Revoke** mean the project was never built or was
withdrawn. I drop projects whose *original* permit holds one of these statuses — unless a
Certificate of Occupancy exists anywhere in the permit chain, in which case the ADU was
built and the project stays (this rescues a handful where only a supplement expired).

```{r step5}
n_before <- nrow(projects)
rescued  <- sum(projects$status_orig %in% invalid_statuses & projects$completed)
projects <- filter(projects, !(status_orig %in% invalid_statuses & !completed))
log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl,
  step = sprintf("5. Drop invalid: original status Expired/Closed/Refund/Revoke with no CofO in chain (%d kept via CofO rescue)", rescued),
  remaining = nrow(projects), dropped = n_before - nrow(projects))
kable(log_tbl, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 7. Step 6 — Normalize Community Plan Area names

The `CPA` field carries spelling variants of the same plan areas (truncated names, a few
comma-joined doubles) plus one genuine boundary change: the 2023 **Downtown Community
Plan** replaced *Central City* and *Central City North*, and newer permits already say
"Downtown." For a consistent series I merge all three into **Downtown**. I spell every
area exactly as LA City Planning's GeoHub boundary file does (`NAME_ALF`), so the spatial
join in the map section is a clean string match.

```{r step6}
cpa_map <- c(
  "Canoga Park-West Hills-Winnetka-Woodland Hill"  = "Canoga Park - Winnetka - Woodland Hills - West Hills",
  "Canoga Park-West Hills-Winnetka-Woodland Hills" = "Canoga Park - Winnetka - Woodland Hills - West Hills",
  "Canoga Park-West Hills-Winnetka-Woodland Hill, Canoga Park-West Hills-Winnetka-Woodland Hills" = "Canoga Park - Winnetka - Woodland Hills - West Hills",
  "Canoga Park - West Hills - Winnetka - Woodland Hills" = "Canoga Park - Winnetka - Woodland Hills - West Hills",
  "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake"       = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga"  = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga Pass" = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga, Sherman Oaks-Studio City-Toluca Lake-Cahuenga Pass" = "Sherman Oaks - Studio City - Toluca Lake - Cahuenga Pass",
  "Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tu"  = "Sunland - Tujunga - Lake View Terrace - Shadow Hills - East La Tuna Canyon",
  "Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tujunga" = "Sunland - Tujunga - Lake View Terrace - Shadow Hills - East La Tuna Canyon",
  "Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tu, Sunland-E LaTuna Cyn-Lakevw Ter-Shadow Hls-Tujunga" = "Sunland - Tujunga - Lake View Terrace - Shadow Hills - East La Tuna Canyon",
  "North Hollywood"     = "North Hollywood - Valley Village",
  "Central City"        = "Downtown",
  "Central City North"  = "Downtown")

projects <- projects %>%
  mutate(cpa = coalesce(recode(cpa_raw, !!!cpa_map), "Unknown"),
         cpa = if_else(is.na(cpa_raw), "Unknown", cpa))
log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl,
  step = sprintf("6. Normalize CPA names (%s projects remapped; %d CPAs)",
                 comma(sum(projects$cpa != coalesce(projects$cpa_raw, "Unknown"))),
                 n_distinct(projects$cpa)),
  remaining = nrow(projects), dropped = 0L)
kable(log_tbl, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 8. Step 7 — Demarcate completed vs. in-progress

**Completed** = a `COFO_DATE` anywhere in the permit chain, or a status of CofO Issued /
CofO Corrected / CofO Superseded / CofC Issued / **Permit Finaled** (final inspection
passed; LADBS left the CofO date blank on a small set of finaled permits).
**In progress** = everything that survived the validity screen but hasn't finished:
Issued, CofO in Progress (CofO paperwork underway but not issued), Re-Activate Permit,
No Progress, Not Ready for Inspection. Completion is as of the November 2026 refresh.

```{r step7}
projects <- projects %>%
  mutate(outcome = if_else(completed, "Completed", "In progress"))
log_tbl <- add_row(log_tbl,
  step = sprintf("7. Demarcate outcome: %s completed / %s in progress",
                 comma(sum(projects$completed)), comma(sum(!projects$completed))),
  remaining = nrow(projects), dropped = 0L)
kable(log_tbl, caption = "Full filtering log", format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# 9. Results

## 9.1 Citywide progression by year

```{r yearly}
yearly <- projects %>%
  group_by(issue_year) %>%
  summarise(projects = n(),
            units_completed   = sum(units[outcome == "Completed"]),
            units_in_progress = sum(units[outcome == "In progress"]),
            units = sum(units)) %>%   # note: total named last so `units` isn't masked above
  relocate(units, .after = projects) %>%
  mutate(pct_completed = percent(units_completed / units, accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  relocate(units_in_progress, .after = units_completed)
kable(yearly, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
      col.names = c("Issue year","ADU projects (permits)","ADU units",
                    "Units completed","Units in progress","% completed"),
      caption = "2026 is a partial year. Recent years show lower completion because construction is typically 1-3 years from permit to CofO.")
```

## 9.2 Units by CPA and year

```{r cpa-year}
cpa_year <- projects %>%
  count(cpa, issue_year, wt = units, name = "units") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = issue_year, values_from = units, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
kable(cpa_year, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## 9.3 Focus areas: Arleta–Pacoima, Northeast LA, West Adams–Baldwin Hills–Leimert

```{r focus}
focus_cpas <- c("Arleta - Pacoima", "Northeast Los Angeles",
                "West Adams - Baldwin Hills - Leimert")
focus <- filter(projects, cpa %in% focus_cpas)

focus %>%
  count(issue_year, cpa, wt = units, name = "units") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cpa, values_from = units, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kable(caption = "ADU units permitted by year")

focus %>%
  group_by(cpa, outcome) %>%
  summarise(units = sum(units), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = units) %>%
  kable(caption = "Totals 2017-present by completion status")
```

## 9.4 Property-level collapse (PIN_NBR)

One row per property: how many ADU permits were filed, how many ADU units were
permitted, and of those how many are completed vs. in progress.

```{r pin}
by_property <- projects %>%
  group_by(pin) %>%
  summarise(apn = first(apn), cpa = first(cpa),
            adu_permits_filed = n(),
            adu_units_total = sum(units),
            adu_units_completed = sum(units[outcome == "Completed"]),
            adu_units_in_progress = sum(units[outcome == "In progress"]),
            first_permit_year = min(issue_year),
            last_permit_year = max(issue_year), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(by_property, "adu_properties_by_pin.csv")
write_csv(projects %>% select(-work_desc), "adu_projects.csv")

tibble(
  Measure = c("Distinct properties with ADU permits",
              "...filed exactly one ADU permit", "...filed 2+ permits",
              "...with >=1 completed ADU", "...with >=1 ADU in progress"),
  N = c(nrow(by_property),
        sum(by_property$adu_permits_filed == 1),
        sum(by_property$adu_permits_filed >= 2),
        sum(by_property$adu_units_completed > 0),
        sum(by_property$adu_units_in_progress > 0))) %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## 9.5 Where the focus CPAs rank among all CPAs

Two ranking views, year by year, among the `r "34"` Community Plan Areas that appear in
the permit data (Port of LA and LAX have essentially no residential parcels and no ADU
permits, and are not ranked):

1. **Counts** — rank by ADU units permitted *that year*.
2. **Percent of single-family parcels** — rank by *cumulative* units through that year as
   a share of the CPA's single-family parcels, i.e., penetration of the SF stock.

The single-family parcel denominator comes from the LA County Assessor's 2025 local-roll
parcel layer (eGIS `ASSR_PARCELS_25_View`): parcels with Use Code `01xx` (Single Family
Residence), excluding the condominium, condo-conversion, cooperative, own-your-own,
vacant-land, and non-structural-improvement suffix codes (C, E, F, H, V, X) — which
closely mirrors the Assessor's `SFR` use type — counted within each CPA boundary
(fully-contained rule). *Placeholder:* when we bring in the SCAG land-use dataset, swap
`sf_parcels` for an ADU-**eligible** parcel count per CPA; the code below only touches the
`denom` column, so nothing else changes. Note the numerator includes the (small) number of
ADUs added to multifamily buildings, so the percentage slightly overstates SF-parcel
penetration in multifamily-heavy CPAs.

```{r rankings}
sf_parcels <- read_csv(params$sf_parcels, show_col_types = FALSE)

rank_base <- projects %>%
  filter(cpa != "Unknown") %>%
  count(cpa, issue_year, wt = units, name = "units") %>%
  complete(cpa, issue_year = 2017:2026, fill = list(units = 0))
n_ranked <- n_distinct(rank_base$cpa)

annual <- rank_base %>%
  group_by(issue_year) %>% mutate(rank_n = min_rank(desc(units))) %>% ungroup()

cumul <- rank_base %>%
  arrange(issue_year) %>%
  group_by(cpa) %>% mutate(cum_units = cumsum(units)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(rename(sf_parcels, denom = sf_parcels), by = "cpa") %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * cum_units / denom) %>%
  group_by(issue_year) %>% mutate(rank_pct = min_rank(desc(pct))) %>% ungroup()

# color bands: sequential blues, darker = higher rank
band_bg <- function(r) case_when(r <= 5 ~ "#1F3864", r <= 10 ~ "#2E75B6",
                                 r <= 17 ~ "#BDD7EE", TRUE ~ "#E7E6E6")
band_fg <- function(r) if_else(r <= 10, "white", "black")

rank_cells <- function(df, value_fmt, rank_col, val_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(cell = cell_spec(paste0("#", .data[[rank_col]], " (", value_fmt(.data[[val_col]]), ")"),
                            background = band_bg(.data[[rank_col]]),
                            color = band_fg(.data[[rank_col]]), bold = TRUE)) %>%
    select(cpa, issue_year, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = issue_year, values_from = cell) %>%
    rename(`Community Plan Area` = cpa)
}

legend_note <- paste0("Cell = rank of ", n_ranked, " CPAs (value). Shading: dark blue = top 5, ",
                      "medium blue = 6-10, light blue = 11-17, grey = 18-", n_ranked, ".")

annual %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>%
  rank_cells(function(v) comma(v), "rank_n", "units") %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = paste("Rank by ADU units permitted per year.", legend_note)) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

cumul %>% filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>%
  rank_cells(function(v) sprintf("%.1f%%", v), "rank_pct", "pct") %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, caption = paste(
    "Rank by CUMULATIVE ADU units as % of single-family parcels, through each year.", legend_note)) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

And the full 2026 standings (cumulative, 2017 through Nov 2026), with our three focus
CPAs highlighted:

```{r rankings-full}
standings <- cumul %>% filter(issue_year == 2026) %>%
  mutate(rank_units = min_rank(desc(cum_units))) %>%
  arrange(rank_pct)
standings %>%
  transmute(`Rank (% of SF parcels)` = rank_pct,
            `Community Plan Area` = cpa,
            `ADU units 2017-2026` = comma(cum_units),
            `SF parcels` = comma(denom),
            `Units per 100 SF parcels` = sprintf("%.1f", pct),
            `Rank (units)` = rank_units) %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = TRUE, align = c("c","l","r","r","r","c"),
        caption = "Cumulative standings through Nov 2026. SF parcels: LA County Assessor 2025 roll, single-family use codes (see text).") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed","striped"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(which(standings$cpa %in% focus_cpas), bold = TRUE, background = "#FFF2CC")
```

### Choropleth: cumulative ADUs by CPA, 2017 – Nov 2026

Companion maps to the standings table: cumulative ADU units permitted per CPA, and the
completed subset, on a **shared** bin scale so the two read side by side (a lighter
completed map = more of that CPA's pipeline still under construction). Bins are
quantile-based on the all-units distribution, rounded for legibility. Focus CPAs are
outlined in black.

```{r rankings-map, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
if (!exists("cpa_sf")) cpa_sf <- st_read(params$cpa_geojson, quiet = TRUE)
cpa_map_sf <- cpa_sf %>%
  filter(!NAME_ALF %in% c("Port of Los Angeles", "Los Angeles International Airport")) %>%
  rename(cpa = NAME_ALF)

cum_by_cpa <- projects %>% filter(cpa != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(cpa) %>%
  summarise(`All ADU units` = sum(units),
            `Completed ADU units` = sum(units[outcome == "Completed"]), .groups = "drop")

cpa_join <- cpa_map_sf %>% left_join(cum_by_cpa, by = "cpa")
choro <- bind_rows(   # explicit long format (keeps the sf class, unlike pivot_longer)
  cpa_join %>% mutate(measure = "All ADU units",       value = `All ADU units`),
  cpa_join %>% mutate(measure = "Completed ADU units", value = `Completed ADU units`)) %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("All ADU units", "Completed ADU units")),
         value = replace_na(value, 0))

# shared bins: quantiles of the ALL-units distribution, rounded to clean numbers
v <- cum_by_cpa$`All ADU units`
brks <- unique(c(0, round(quantile(v, probs = seq(1/7, 6/7, length.out = 6)) / 50) * 50,
                 ceiling(max(v) / 100) * 100))
lab_fmt <- function(b) paste0(comma(head(b, -1) + 1), " - ", comma(tail(b, -1)))
choro <- choro %>% mutate(bin = cut(value, breaks = brks, labels = lab_fmt(brks),
                                    include.lowest = TRUE))

# short anchor labels (first segment of the CPA name), placed inside each polygon
labs_sf <- cpa_map_sf %>%
  mutate(short = str_trim(str_split_fixed(cpa, "-", 2)[, 1]),
         short = recode(short, "West Adams" = "West Adams-BH-Leimert",
                        "Arleta" = "Arleta-Pacoima")) %>%
  st_point_on_surface()

focus_outline <- filter(cpa_map_sf, cpa %in% focus_cpas)

g_choro <- ggplot(choro) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = bin), color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = focus_outline, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_sf_text(data = labs_sf, aes(label = short), size = 1.9, color = "grey25",
               fun.geometry = sf::st_point_on_surface) +
  facet_wrap(~measure) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", name = "ADU units,\n2017 - Nov 2026", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Cumulative ADU units by Community Plan Area, 2017 - November 2026",
       subtitle = "Shared bins across both panels; focus CPAs outlined in black",
       caption = "LADBS permits (see filtering log); completed = CofO issued or permit finaled as of Nov 2026") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/map_cpa_choropleth.png", g_choro, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
g_choro
```

# 10. Validation against published counts

As a replication check, I compare my counts to the LADBS-based academic studies and the
most-cited public tallies. The short version: **LADBS-derived counts (mine, Crane,
Brueckner & Thomaz, Crosstown) agree once definitional differences are applied, while HCD
Annual Progress Report self-reports run 30–50% higher** and should not be pooled with
LADBS-based series.

```{r validation}
tribble(
  ~Benchmark, ~Period, ~`Their count`, ~`My count`, ~Assessment,
  "Crane (2020), UCLA dissertation - LADBS permits",
    "2017-2018", "'over 6,000' ADUs permitted", "5,719 projects / 5,723 units (5,916 raw rows)",
    "Within ~5%. Crane counted c. 2019-20, before ~131 of those permits expired/closed (I drop them as invalid); raw rows incl. supplements close most of the rest. Replicates.",
  "Brueckner & Thomaz (2024), Real Estate Economics - LA City Planning permits",
    "Cumulative through 2019", "8,097 parcels (2017: 1,693; 2018: 3,193; 2019: 2,888)", "10,305 projects, 2017-2019",
    "Mine is higher by design: they keep only single-family parcels and drop outlier parcels, excluding the multifamily conversions I keep. Their 2017 (1,693) is close to mine (1,606); their 2019 dip suggests a mid-year data cut. Consistent.",
  "HCD Annual Progress Reports (City self-reports)",
    "2017-2024", "2017: 2,342 | 2018: 4,079 | 2019: 6,747 | 2023: 9,358 | 2024: 9,849 units", "2017: 1,607 | 2018: 4,116 | 2019: 4,596 | 2023: 6,713 | 2024: 7,191 units",
    "APR runs 30-50% higher most years (2018 nearly matches). Known discrepancy: APRs are planning-department unit counts self-reported for RHNA credit, with a broader net (resubmittals, movable units, units later expired). Different universe, not an error in either series.",
  "Crosstown LA - same LADBS dataset",
    "2020 - Apr 30, 2025", "26,835 ADUs permitted", "~30,400 projects, same window",
    "Mine ~13% higher: the structural-inventory fields capture JADUs, multifamily storage/garage conversions, and ADUs embedded in larger permits that description-based counts can miss. Same source, slightly wider net. Consistent."
) %>% kable()
```

Sources: Crane, R. E. (2020), *Is Granny in that Flat?*, UCLA PhD dissertation
([eScholarship](https://escholarship.org/uc/item/2wh204vz)); Brueckner, J. K. & Thomaz, S.
(2024), "ADUs in Los Angeles: Where Are They Located and by How Much Do They Raise Property
Value?", *Real Estate Economics* 52(3): 885–907
([working paper](https://sites.socsci.uci.edu/~jkbrueck/ADUs.pdf)); California HCD Annual
Progress Report Table A2 compilations
([PermitPathLA](https://permitpath.la/data/adu-permits-by-city),
[backyardadu.net](https://backyardadu.net/statistics/)); Crosstown LA counts as reported in
[The Eastsider](https://www.theeastsiderla.com/neighborhoods/highland_park/a-small-building-boom-highland-park-and-eagle-rock-lead-the-eastside-in-adu-construction/article_17ec16fd-aa36-474d-a8d5-e133536284da.html).

# 12. Maps

Boundaries come straight from LA City Planning's
[Community Plan Areas layer on GeoHub](https://geohub.lacity.org/datasets/f4e830d3882d457bb9d9241cdff0b10a_0/explore)
(the `cpa_geojson` param queries its feature service as GeoJSON); CPA names there
(`NAME_ALF`) match my normalized names exactly. A small number of permits lack usable
coordinates and are noted below; everything else plots from `LAT`/`LON` of the project's
first ADU-flagged permit.

All maps sit on a light, Positron-style basemap — **Esri World Light Gray Canvas** with
its minimal label overlay, just enough to anchor the geography — fetched as XYZ tiles by
the small helper below; no extra packages needed beyond `png`, and no API key. (CARTO's
own Positron tiles now require an API key for direct access.) If the tile server is
unreachable, maps fall back to a plain background.
For the focus CPAs, permits are drawn as **parcel polygons** (County Assessor 2025 parcel
layer, `ASSR_PARCELS_25_View`, joined on 10-digit AIN/APN); the few projects whose APN
doesn't match a parcel fall back to dots.

```{r map-setup}
cpa_sf <- st_read(params$cpa_geojson, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!NAME_ALF %in% c("Port of Los Angeles", "Los Angeles International Airport"))

bb <- st_bbox(cpa_sf)   # clip to the city's bounding box: a handful of permits geocode far outside LA
pts <- projects %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon),
         lat >= bb["ymin"], lat <= bb["ymax"],
         lon >= bb["xmin"], lon <= bb["xmax"]) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
cat(sprintf("Projects without usable coordinates: %s of %s\n",
            comma(nrow(projects) - nrow(pts)), comma(nrow(projects))))

## --- Light basemap helper: Esri World Light Gray Canvas (base + label overlay) ---
## CARTO Positron-style: light grey, minimal labels; free XYZ tiles, no API key.
lon2x <- function(lon, z) (lon + 180) / 360 * 2^z
lat2y <- function(lat, z) (1 - log(tan(lat*pi/180) + 1/cos(lat*pi/180))/pi) / 2 * 2^z
tile_src <- c(
  base = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/%d/%d/%d",
  ref  = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/%d/%d/%d")
read_tile <- function(f) {   # Esri serves base tiles as JPEG, the label overlay as PNG
  magic <- readBin(f, "raw", 3)
  if (identical(magic, as.raw(c(0x89, 0x50, 0x4e)))) png::readPNG(f)
  else if (identical(magic[1:2], as.raw(c(0xff, 0xd8)))) jpeg::readJPEG(f)
  else stop("not an image")
}
light_basemap <- function(bb4326, zoom, cache_dir = "tiles") {
  dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  x0 <- floor(lon2x(bb4326[["xmin"]], zoom)); x1 <- floor(lon2x(bb4326[["xmax"]], zoom))
  y0 <- floor(lat2y(bb4326[["ymax"]], zoom)); y1 <- floor(lat2y(bb4326[["ymin"]], zoom))
  img <- array(1, dim = c(256*(y1-y0+1), 256*(x1-x0+1), 3))   # white fallback
  for (tx in x0:x1) for (ty in y0:y1) {
    tile <- NULL
    for (layer in names(tile_src)) {
      f <- file.path(cache_dir, sprintf("%s_%d_%d_%d.png", layer, zoom, tx, ty))
      if (!file.exists(f))   # Esri tile scheme is z/y/x
        try(download.file(sprintf(tile_src[[layer]], zoom, ty, tx),
                          f, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
      if (file.exists(f) && file.size(f) > 0) {
        p <- try(read_tile(f), silent = TRUE)
        if (!inherits(p, "try-error")) {
          if (length(dim(p)) == 2) p <- array(rep(p, 3), dim = c(dim(p), 3))
          if (is.null(tile)) tile <- array(1, dim = c(dim(p)[1], dim(p)[2], 3))
          if (dim(p)[3] >= 4) {          # label overlay: alpha-composite
            a <- p[, , 4]
            for (ch in 1:3) tile[, , ch] <- p[, , ch]*a + tile[, , ch]*(1 - a)
          } else tile <- p[, , 1:3]
        }
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(tile))
      img[(ty-y0)*256 + 1:256, (tx-x0)*256 + 1:256, ] <- tile
  }
  R <- 6378137
  list(img = img,
       ext = c(xmin = (x0/2^zoom*2 - 1)*pi*R,     xmax = ((x1+1)/2^zoom*2 - 1)*pi*R,
               ymin = (1 - (y1+1)/2^zoom*2)*pi*R, ymax = (1 - y0/2^zoom*2)*pi*R))
}
carto_positron <- light_basemap   # kept for compatibility
basemap_layer <- function(bm, fade = 0) {   # fade: 0 = full basemap, 1 = white
  img <- if (fade > 0) bm$img * (1 - fade) + fade else bm$img
  annotation_raster(img, bm$ext[["xmin"]], bm$ext[["xmax"]],
                    bm$ext[["ymin"]], bm$ext[["ymax"]])
}
# zoom so the bbox spans ~`tiles` tiles horizontally (capped)
zoom_for <- function(bb4326, tiles = 4)
  min(15L, max(9L, floor(log2(360 * tiles / (bb4326[["xmax"]] - bb4326[["xmin"]])))))
carto_credit <- "Basemap: Esri World Light Gray Canvas | Esri, HERE, Garmin, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors"

## --- Focus-CPA parcel polygons (County Assessor), joined to projects on AIN/APN ---
parcels <- st_read(params$parcels_focus, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(ain = gsub("\\D", "", AIN)) %>%
  select(ain, parcel_cpa = cpa)
proj_focus <- projects %>%
  filter(cpa %in% focus_cpas) %>%
  mutate(apn10 = gsub("\\D", "", apn))
parcel_map <- parcels %>%
  inner_join(select(proj_focus, apn10, cpa, issue_year, outcome, units),
             by = c("ain" = "apn10"))
unmatched <- proj_focus %>% filter(!apn10 %in% parcels$ain)
cat(sprintf("Focus-CPA projects matched to a parcel polygon: %s of %s (%.1f%%)\n",
            comma(n_distinct(parcel_map$ain)), comma(nrow(proj_focus)),
            100 * (1 - nrow(unmatched) / nrow(proj_focus))))
unmatched_pts <- unmatched %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
```

```{r map-city, fig.height=10}
pts_3857 <- st_transform(pts, 3857)
bbc <- st_bbox(cpa_3857)
bm_city <- carto_positron(st_bbox(cpa_sf), zoom = zoom_for(st_bbox(cpa_sf), tiles = 3))

ggplot() +
```

## 12.2 Focus CPAs, close-up

```{r map-focus, fig.height=8, results='asis'}
for (area in focus_cpas) {
  bdry  <- filter(cpa_sf, NAME_ALF == area)
  bdryM <- st_transform(bdry, 3857)
  bbm   <- st_bbox(bdryM)

    { if (nrow(up) > 0) geom_sf(data = up, aes(color = outcome), size = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) } +

         subtitle = "Shaded parcels = properties with an ADU permit; color = completion status as of Nov 2026",
         caption = carto_credit) +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(g)
}
```

## 12.3 Parcel data note

`parcels_focus.geojson` holds the parcel polygons for the three focus CPAs, pulled from
the County Assessor's 2025 parcel layer
(eGIS `ASSR_PARCELS_25_View`, fields `AIN`/`APN`/`UseCode`, ~0.5 m generalization) with
one intersects-query per CPA boundary. Projects join to parcels on the 10-digit AIN/APN;
the match rate is printed in the map-setup chunk above, and unmatched projects (bad or
retired APNs) are drawn as dots. To swap in the City's own parcel layer instead
([LA City Parcels on GeoHub](https://geohub.lacity.org/datasets/lahub::la-city-parcels/about),
which joins on the city `PIN` = our `pin` column), point `params$parcels_focus` at that
file and change the join keys — nothing else moves.

# 13. GIF frames (cumulative progression)

For the animations I use **cumulative** permits — each frame shows everything permitted
through that year — which reads as growth rather than a flickering scatter. Frames are
written as PNGs and stitched with `gifski`. Set `params$make_gifs = TRUE` (or knit with
`rmarkdown::render("...", params = list(make_gifs = TRUE))`) to build them; at roughly one
second per frame this adds a few minutes.

```{r gifs, eval=params$make_gifs}
# install.packages("gifski") once; without it, frames are still written to frames/
have_gifski <- requireNamespace("gifski", quietly = TRUE)
dir.create("frames", showWarnings = FALSE)
years <- sort(unique(pts$issue_year))

gif_one <- function(label, draw_frame) {
  dir.create(file.path("frames", label), showWarnings = FALSE)
  files <- character(0)
  for (y in years) {
    f <- file.path("frames", label, sprintf("%s_%d.png", label, y))
    ggsave(f, draw_frame(y), width = 7, height = 7.5, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
    files <- c(files, f)
  }
  if (have_gifski) {
    gifski::gifski(files, gif_file = paste0("adu_", label, ".gif"),
                   width = 1050, height = 1125, delay = 0.8)
  } else message("gifski not installed - frames written to frames/", label,
                 "; assemble them with gifski or any GIF tool")
}

# cumulative count line shown on every frame: running total, split, and that year's additions
count_line <- function(cum_units, cum_done, cum_prog, new_units, y, place) {
  paste0(place, "\n", comma(cum_units), " ADU units permitted through ", y,
         " (", comma(cum_done), " completed, ", comma(cum_prog), " in progress)",
         "  |  +", comma(new_units), " in ", y)
}

# citywide: dots over the basemap, cumulative through each year
gif_one("citywide", function(y) {
  cum <- filter(pts_3857, issue_year <= y)
  sub <- count_line(sum(cum$units), sum(cum$units[cum$outcome == "Completed"]),
                    sum(cum$units[cum$outcome == "In progress"]),
                    sum(pts_3857$units[pts_3857$issue_year == y]), y, "City of Los Angeles")
  ggplot() +
    basemap_layer(bm_city) +
    geom_sf(data = cpa_3857, fill = NA, color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_sf(data = cum, aes(color = outcome), size = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal_outcome, name = NULL, drop = FALSE,
                       limits = names(pal_outcome),
                       guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
    coord_sf(crs = 3857, xlim = c(bbc[["xmin"]], bbc[["xmax"]]),
             ylim = c(bbc[["ymin"]], bbc[["ymax"]]), expand = FALSE, datum = NA) +
    labs(title = paste0("ADU permits through ", y), subtitle = sub,
         caption = carto_credit) +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "top",
                         plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10))
})

# focus CPAs: shaded parcels over the basemap, cumulative through each year
for (area in focus_cpas) {
  bdryM <- st_transform(filter(cpa_sf, NAME_ALF == area), 3857)
  bbm   <- st_bbox(bdryM)
  bmF   <- carto_positron(st_bbox(filter(cpa_sf, NAME_ALF == area)),
                          zoom = zoom_for(st_bbox(filter(cpa_sf, NAME_ALF == area)), tiles = 5))
  pmA   <- parcel_map %>% filter(cpa == area) %>% st_transform(3857)
  upA   <- unmatched_pts %>% filter(cpa == area) %>% st_transform(3857)
  all_units_A <- sum(pmA$units) + sum(upA$units)
  gif_one(str_replace_all(tolower(area), "[^a-z]+", "_"), function(y) {
    cumP <- filter(pmA, issue_year <= y)
    cumU <- filter(upA, issue_year <= y)
    cu <- sum(cumP$units) + sum(cumU$units)
    cd <- sum(cumP$units[cumP$outcome == "Completed"]) + sum(cumU$units[cumU$outcome == "Completed"])
    ny <- sum(pmA$units[pmA$issue_year == y]) + sum(upA$units[upA$issue_year == y])
    sub <- count_line(cu, cd, cu - cd, ny, y, area)
    ggplot() +
      basemap_layer(bmF) +
      geom_sf(data = bdryM, fill = NA, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_sf(data = cumP, aes(fill = outcome), color = NA) +
      { if (nrow(cumU) > 0) geom_sf(data = cumU, aes(color = outcome),
                                    size = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) } +
      scale_fill_manual(values = pal_outcome, name = NULL, drop = FALSE,
                        limits = names(pal_outcome)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = pal_outcome, guide = "none") +
      coord_sf(crs = 3857, xlim = c(bbm[["xmin"]], bbm[["xmax"]]),
               ylim = c(bbm[["ymin"]], bbm[["ymax"]]), expand = FALSE, datum = NA) +
      labs(title = paste0("ADU permits through ", y), subtitle = sub,
           caption = carto_credit) +
      theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "top",
                           plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10))
  })
}
```

# 14. Animations

Cumulative growth of ADU permits, one frame per year — citywide and in each focus CPA.
Every frame reports the running unit total (split by completion status) and the units
added that year. Parcels are shaded in the CPA animations; blue = completed,
orange = in progress as of Nov 2026.

```{r show-gifs, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
gif_files <- c("adu_citywide.gif",
               paste0("adu_", str_replace_all(tolower(focus_cpas), "[^a-z]+", "_"), ".gif"))
shown <- FALSE
for (g in gif_files) if (file.exists(g)) { cat(sprintf("![](%s)\n\n", g)); shown <- TRUE }
if (!shown) cat("*Animations not built in this knit — render with `params = list(make_gifs = TRUE)` to generate them.*\n")
```

---

*Pipeline decisions were set on November 7, 2026. Rebuilding from a newer LADBS refresh
only requires updating the two file paths in the YAML params; the typo-fix list in Step 3
should be re-checked against any project exceeding ~10 units.*
